thread.title: Apple target hiked at UBS ahead of iPhone event - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple target hiked at UBS ahead of iPhone event - MarketWatch
text:
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri raised his Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.16% price target to $250 from $215 on Tuesday, writing that the company has "one of the planet's only recurring hardware revenue streams." He estimates that the smartphone replacement cycle is stabilizing after two years of "elongation," and he anticipates a "two-year purchase cadence" in the U.S. and Western Europe. Apple is preparing to launch its new iPhone lineup on Wednesday, and Arcuri expects that the company will start its cheapest new model at $699, its enhanced iPhone X at $969, and its large-screen iPhone X at $1069. Apple shares are little changed in Tuesday trading, and they're up 35% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.27% is up 17% over that time.
